title: "POST /api/roles/sync (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive RolesSyncRequest
    q_validate --> q_check_uid: validate discord_uid is string
    q_validate --> q_error: discord_uid missing or invalid
    q_check_uid --> q_fetch_roles: lookup user by discord_uid
    q_check_uid --> q_error: user not found
    q_fetch_roles --> q_compute_diff: fetch current and expected roles
    q_compute_diff --> q_assign: compute roles_assigned list
    q_assign --> q_remove: compute roles_removed list
    q_remove --> q_respond: success = true
    q_respond --> [*]: return RolesSyncResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: discord_uid must be a non-empty string
        INV-002: response roles_assigned and roles_removed are disjoint sets
    end note

    note right of q_respond
        INV-003: success = true implies roles_assigned and roles_removed are valid arrays
    end note

---
title: "GET /api/nickname (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive request with discord_uid
    q_validate --> q_lookup: validate discord_uid parameter
    q_validate --> q_error: invalid or missing discord_uid
    q_lookup --> q_parse: fetch full_nickname for user
    q_lookup --> q_error: user not found
    q_parse --> q_respond: extract name_only from full_nickname
    q_respond --> [*]: return NicknameResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_parse
        INV-001: name_only is a substring derived from full_nickname
        INV-002: discord_uid in response matches requested uid
    end note

title: "POST /api/nickname/update (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive NicknameUpdateRequest
    q_validate --> q_check_uid: validate discord_uid and name
    q_validate --> q_error: missing or invalid fields
    q_check_uid --> q_lookup: lookup user by discord_uid
    q_check_uid --> q_error: user not found
    q_lookup --> q_update: compute updated_nickname from name
    q_update --> q_apply: apply nickname change to Discord
    q_apply --> q_respond: success = true
    q_apply --> q_error: Discord API failure
    q_respond --> [*]: return NicknameUpdateResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: discord_uid must be a non-empty string
        INV-002: name must be a non-empty string
    end note

    note right of q_respond
        INV-003: updated_nickname contains the new name value
        INV-004: success = true implies nickname was persisted
    end note

stateDiagram-v2

    q_validate --> q_check_gen: validate generation is number
    q_validate --> q_error: generation missing or not a number
    q_check_gen --> q_create_role: create Discord role for generation
    q_check_gen --> q_error: generation already exists
    q_create_role --> q_respond: success = true, return role_id
    q_create_role --> q_error: Discord API failure
    q_respond --> [*]: return GenerationCreateResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: generation must be a positive integer
    end note

    note right of q_respond
        INV-002: role_id is a valid Discord snowflake string
        INV-003: generation in response matches request generation
    end note

title: "GET /api/member/status (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive request with discord_uid
    q_validate --> q_lookup: validate discord_uid parameter
    q_validate --> q_error: invalid or missing discord_uid
    q_lookup --> q_check_server: fetch member from Discord
    q_lookup --> q_not_found: member not in guild

    q_respond --> [*]: return MemberStatusResponse
    q_respond_absent --> [*]: return MemberStatusResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_check_server
        INV-001: discord_uid in response matches requested uid

        INV-003: is_in_server = false implies current_nickname = null
        INV-004: is_in_server = false implies current_roles is empty array
    end note

title: "POST /api/roles/assign (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive RoleAssignRequest
    q_validate --> q_check_params: validate discord_uid and discord_role_id
    q_validate --> q_error: missing or invalid fields
    q_check_params --> q_lookup_user: lookup user by discord_uid
    q_check_params --> q_error: invalid discord_uid or discord_role_id

    q_lookup_user --> q_error: user not found
    q_check_role --> q_assign: assign role to user
    q_check_role --> q_error: role not found
    q_assign --> q_respond: success = true
    q_assign --> q_error: Discord API failure or permission denied
    q_respond --> [*]: return RoleAssignResponse

        INV-004: target role must be lower than bot highest role in hierarchy
    end note

stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: receive RoleRemoveRequest
    q_validate --> q_check_params: validate discord_uid and discord_role_id
    q_validate --> q_error: missing or invalid fields
    q_check_params --> q_lookup_user: lookup user by discord_uid
    q_check_params --> q_error: invalid discord_uid or discord_role_id
    q_lookup_user --> q_check_role: verify user has the role
    q_lookup_user --> q_error: user not found
    q_check_role --> q_remove: remove role from user
    q_check_role --> q_error: role not assigned to user
    q_remove --> q_respond: success = true
    q_remove --> q_error: Discord API failure or permission denied
    q_respond --> [*]: return RoleRemoveResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_validate

        INV-002: discord_role_id must be a non-empty string
    end note

    note right of q_remove
        INV-003: bot must have MANAGE_ROLES permission
        INV-004: target role must be lower than bot highest role in hierarchy
    end note

title: "GET /api/roles/discord-list (API Types: api.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_fetch: fetch all roles from Discord guild
    q_fetch --> q_map: map roles to DiscordRole objects
    q_fetch --> q_error: Discord API failure
    q_map --> q_iter: for each role extract id, name, color, position
    q_iter --> q_iter: next role
    q_iter --> q_respond: all roles mapped, success = true
    q_respond --> [*]: return DiscordRoleListResponse
    q_error --> [*]: return ErrorResponse

    note right of q_map
        INV-001: each DiscordRole has unique id
        INV-002: position is a non-negative integer
        INV-003: roles array is sorted by position or preserves Discord ordering
    end note

    note right of q_respond
        INV-004: success = true implies roles is a valid non-null array
    end note

---
title: "member_lifecycle (database.ts: Member)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate_auth: validate supabase_auth_user_id
    q_validate_auth --> q_check_discord: supabase_auth_user_id is valid
    q_validate_auth --> q_error_auth: supabase_auth_user_id is empty
    q_error_auth --> [*]: revert "invalid auth user id"
    q_check_discord --> q_set_defaults: discord_uid is valid
    q_check_discord --> q_error_discord: discord_uid is empty
    q_error_discord --> [*]: revert "invalid discord uid"
    q_set_defaults --> q_insert: status = 0, is_admin = false, joined_at = now()
    q_insert --> q_active: insert Member record
    q_active --> q_update_status: update status
    q_active --> q_update_profile: update avatar_url or student_number
    q_update_status --> q_active: status updated
    q_update_profile --> q_active: profile updated
    q_active --> q_promote_admin: is_admin = true
    q_promote_admin --> q_active: admin granted
    q_active --> q_soft_delete: deleted_at = now()
    q_soft_delete --> [*]: member soft-deleted

    note right of q_validate_auth
        INV-001: supabase_auth_user_id must be non-empty string
        INV-002: discord_uid must be non-empty string
    end note

    note right of q_active
        INV-003: joined_at is immutable after creation
        INV-004: deleted_at is null while member is active
        INV-005: status is a numeric enum (0, 1, ...)
    end note

    note right of q_soft_delete
        INV-006: deleted_at != null implies member is inactive
        INV-007: soft-deleted members should not be re-activated without clearing deleted_at
    end note

---
title: "team_management (database.ts: Team)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate_input: validate name and discord_role_id
    q_validate_input --> q_check_unique: name is non-empty and discord_role_id is non-empty
    q_validate_input --> q_error: name or discord_role_id is empty
    q_error --> [*]: revert "invalid team input"
    q_check_unique --> q_generate_id: no duplicate name or discord_role_id
    q_check_unique --> q_error_dup: duplicate exists
    q_error_dup --> [*]: revert "team already exists"
    q_generate_id --> q_insert: id = generate_uuid()
    q_insert --> q_active: insert Team record
    q_active --> q_update_name: update name
    q_update_name --> q_active: name updated
    q_active --> q_update_role: update discord_role_id
    q_update_role --> q_active: discord_role_id updated
    q_active --> q_delete: delete Team record
    q_delete --> q_cascade_check: check MemberTeamRelation and TeamLeader references
    q_cascade_check --> [*]: cascade delete or orphan check complete

    note right of q_validate_input
        INV-001: team id is auto-generated UUID
        INV-002: name must be non-empty string
        INV-003: discord_role_id must be non-empty string
    end note

    note right of q_cascade_check
        INV-004: deleting a team must handle MemberTeamRelation foreign keys
        INV-005: deleting a team must handle TeamLeader foreign keys
    end note

---
title: "member_team_assignment (database.ts: MemberTeamRelation)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate_member: validate member_id exists in Member
    q_validate_member --> q_validate_team: member_id references active Member
    q_validate_member --> q_error_member: member_id not found or soft-deleted
    q_error_member --> [*]: revert "invalid member_id"
    q_validate_team --> q_check_duplicate: team_id references existing Team
    q_validate_team --> q_error_team: team_id not found
    q_error_team --> [*]: revert "invalid team_id"
    q_check_duplicate --> q_insert: no existing (member_id, team_id) pair
    q_check_duplicate --> q_error_dup: relation already exists
    q_error_dup --> [*]: revert "duplicate assignment"
    q_insert --> q_assigned: insert MemberTeamRelation record
    q_assigned --> q_remove: delete MemberTeamRelation record
    q_remove --> [*]: member removed from team

    note right of q_validate_member
        INV-001: member_id must reference an existing Member record
        INV-002: team_id must reference an existing Team record
    end note

    note right of q_check_duplicate
        INV-003: (member_id, team_id) pair must be unique (composite primary key)
    end note

    note right of q_assigned
        INV-004: a member can belong to multiple teams
        INV-005: a team can have multiple members
    end note

---
title: "team_leader_assignment (database.ts: TeamLeader)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate_team: validate team_id exists in Team
    q_validate_team --> q_validate_member: team_id references existing Team
    q_validate_team --> q_error_team: team_id not found
    q_error_team --> [*]: revert "invalid team_id"
    q_validate_member --> q_check_membership: member_id references active Member
    q_validate_member --> q_error_member: member_id not found or soft-deleted
    q_error_member --> [*]: revert "invalid member_id"
    q_check_membership --> q_check_existing_leader: member is in team (MemberTeamRelation exists)
    q_check_membership --> q_error_not_member: member not in team
    q_error_not_member --> [*]: revert "member not in team"
    q_check_existing_leader --> q_insert: no existing leader for team_id
    q_check_existing_leader --> q_replace: leader already exists for team_id
    q_replace --> q_insert: delete old TeamLeader record
    q_insert --> q_assigned: insert TeamLeader record
    q_assigned --> q_revoke: delete TeamLeader record
    q_revoke --> [*]: leader revoked

    note right of q_validate_member
        INV-001: team_id must reference an existing Team
        INV-002: member_id must reference an existing Member
    end note

    note right of q_check_membership
        INV-003: leader must be a member of the team (MemberTeamRelation must exist)
    end note

    note right of q_check_existing_leader
        INV-004: each team has at most one leader (team_id is unique key in TeamLeader)
    end note

    note right of q_assigned
        INV-005: revoking a leader does not remove them from the team
    end note

---
title: "generation_role_mapping (database.ts: GenerationRole)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate_gen: validate generation is positive integer
    q_validate_gen --> q_validate_role: generation > 0
    q_validate_gen --> q_error_gen: generation <= 0 or non-integer
    q_error_gen --> [*]: revert "invalid generation number"
    q_validate_role --> q_check_duplicate: discord_role_id is non-empty
    q_validate_role --> q_error_role: discord_role_id is empty
    q_error_role --> [*]: revert "invalid discord_role_id"
    q_check_duplicate --> q_insert: no existing mapping for generation
    q_check_duplicate --> q_error_dup: generation already mapped
    q_error_dup --> [*]: revert "generation role already exists"
    q_insert --> q_active: insert GenerationRole record
    q_active --> q_update_role: update discord_role_id
    q_update_role --> q_active: discord_role_id updated
    q_active --> q_delete: delete GenerationRole record
    q_delete --> [*]: generation role mapping removed

    note right of q_validate_gen
        INV-001: generation must be a positive integer
        INV-002: discord_role_id must be non-empty string
    end note

    note right of q_check_duplicate
        INV-003: generation is unique key (one discord role per generation)
        INV-004: discord_role_id should be unique across generations
    end note

    note right of q_active
        INV-005: Member.generation must reference a valid GenerationRole.generation
    end note
